summary: Test playbooks in a non-production environment with ansible-navigator, a TUI that runs content in execution environments; ansible-navigator run <playbook> --eei <ee_image> replicates the AAP production setup and lets you step into each play and task.
questions: How do I test a playbook against an execution environment?
ansible-navigator run with a specific execution environment image
How can I replicate my AAP environment when testing playbooks locally?

answer_card.title: Test a playbook in an execution environment
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
ansible-navigator run site.yml --eei ee-minimal-rhel8
```
`--eei` (`--execution-environment-image`) picks the EE so the test matches how Ansible Automation Platform runs the job. Run it against a lab or VM, then step into each play and task in the output.
